# LeapView

> Dashboards-as-code BI with generated, machine-readable CLI, API, configuration, and visual documentation.

## Agent entry points

- [Documentation MCP](/mcp): read-only Streamable HTTP MCP with docs_catalog, docs_search, and docs_read tools.
- [Agent tool manifest](/docs/agent-tools/manifest.json): generated names, privileges, defaults, annotations, and input/output schemas.
- [CLI manifest](/docs/cli/manifest.json): versioned command syntax, arguments, flags, defaults, side effects, and confirmation behavior.
- [API operation manifest](/docs/api/operations.json): versioned operation IDs, routes, authorization, safety metadata, and request/response schemas.
- [OpenAPI schema](/docs/openapi.yaml): complete generated OpenAPI contract.

Focused slices are available at `/docs/agent-tools/tools/{name}.json|md`, `/docs/cli/commands/{id}.json|md`, and `/docs/api/operations/{operationId}.json|md`. Prefer search and focused reads over loading complete manifests. Public documentation tools never execute tools, commands, or API operations.

## Documentation

### Start here

- [What is LeapView?](/docs/introduction): Understand the problems LeapView solves and its code-native model.
- [Installation](/docs/installation): Pull the public image locally or prepare a durable production instance.
- [Get started with LeapView](/docs/getting-started): Choose a path from installation through your first validated dashboard change.
- [Build your first dashboard](/docs/first-dashboard): Change a model and dashboard and deploy it locally.
- [Project structure](/docs/project-structure): Learn how project-wide resources are organized.

### Core concepts

- [Core concepts](/docs/concepts): A map of the concepts used throughout LeapView.
- [Projects and environments](/docs/concepts/projects-environments): Understand ownership, isolation, and deployment scope.
- [Connections and sources](/docs/concepts/connections-sources): Separate physical data access from reusable logical source definitions.
- [Managed data and revisions](/docs/concepts/managed-data): Understand immutable revisions, staging, activation, upload boundaries, and storage ownership.
- [Model tables](/docs/concepts/model-tables): Materialize reusable analytical tables from source data.
- [Semantic models](/docs/concepts/semantic-models): Define datasets, dimensions, metrics, and relationships once.
- [Apache Ossie interchange](/docs/concepts/ossie-interchange): Import and export semantic models through the pinned Ossie boundary.
- [Dashboards, pages, and visuals](/docs/concepts/dashboards): Understand the presentation resources rendered from the project graph.
- [Query and interaction lifecycle](/docs/concepts/query-lifecycle): Follow a user interaction from signals through DuckDB and back.

### Use LeapView Desktop

- [LeapView Desktop](/docs/desktop): Understand the end-user client and what remains owned by the deployed instance.
- [Install LeapView Desktop](/docs/desktop/install): Choose, install, and remove the supported native package for your operating system.
- [Connect instances and manage profiles](/docs/desktop/connect-profiles): Add a deployed instance and safely rename, disconnect, remove, or replace its profile.
- [Desktop authentication and sessions](/docs/desktop/authentication): Understand browser authentication, loopback PKCE, session lifetime, and revocation.
- [Update LeapView Desktop](/docs/desktop/updates): Use the trusted stable channel on macOS and Windows or signed APT on Ubuntu.
- [Troubleshoot LeapView Desktop](/docs/desktop/support): Diagnose network, authentication, session, recovery, and update problems without exposing secrets.
- [Desktop security boundaries](/docs/desktop/security): Review trusted and untrusted surfaces, local data, networking, packages, and v1 non-goals.
- [Verify a desktop release](/docs/desktop/release-verification): Check artifact hashes, signatures, SBOMs, provenance, and channel withdrawal state.

- [Create a dashboard](/docs/guides/build/dashboard): Define a project dashboard and its first report page.
- [Pages and layout](/docs/guides/build/pages-layout): Compose responsive report pages from code.
- [Filters and interactions](/docs/guides/build/filters-interactions): Configure filter cards and cross-visual selections.
- [Tables, matrices, and pivots](/docs/guides/build/tables): Choose and configure tabular BI surfaces.
- [Dashboard authoring patterns](/docs/guides/build/patterns): Apply maintainable modeling and presentation conventions.
- [Visual calculations](/docs/guides/build/visual-calculations): Add governed post-aggregation analysis to one compiled result frame.

### Manage data

- [Managed data ingestion](/docs/data-ingestion): Plan, stage, and activate immutable project-global data revisions.
- [Data revisions and activation](/docs/guides/data/revisions): Understand revision identity and atomic activation.
- [Materialization and refresh](/docs/guides/data/refresh): Refresh model tables without disrupting active queries.
- [Storage and recovery](/docs/guides/data/storage-recovery): Operate local or object-backed analytical storage safely.
- [Data troubleshooting](/docs/guides/data/troubleshooting): Diagnose planning, upload, revision, and refresh failures.

### Deploy and operate

- [Deploy and operate LeapView](/docs/guides/operate): Understand the production delivery and operations workflow.
- [Develop, review, and publish](/docs/cli/validate-deploy): Preview a private target candidate and publish that exact revision.
- [Targets and environments](/docs/cli/targets): Keep local, staging, and production changes explicit.
- [Dashboard authoring and promotion](/docs/guides/operate/dashboard-authoring): Move private dashboard drafts through development, review, and production with explicit ownership boundaries.
- [Production configuration](/docs/guides/operate/production-configuration): Configure secrets, storage, auth, and runtime boundaries.
- [Self-hosting](/docs/guides/operate/self-hosting): Build and run a supported single-node deployment.
- [Health and observability](/docs/guides/operate/observability): Monitor health, query activity, refreshes, and deployments.
- [Backup and restore](/docs/guides/operate/backup-restore): Coordinate external PostgreSQL PITR and DuckLake/object-store recovery; LeapView provides no backup archive.
- [Upgrades and migrations](/docs/guides/operate/upgrades): Plan provider-managed image upgrades and persistent-state migrations with explicit rollback boundaries.
- [Operate the plan → build → publish delivery contract](/docs/guides/operate/plan-build-publish): Bootstrap an admitted physical pool and operate immutable target-bound delivery.
- [Delivery reachability and recovery boundaries](/docs/guides/operate/delivery-recovery): Inspect delivery state and understand the provider-native recovery boundary.
- [Operational troubleshooting](/docs/guides/operate/troubleshooting): Diagnose deployment and runtime failures systematically.

### Security and administration

- [Authentication and authorization](/docs/enterprise-auth): Understand LeapView identity and authorization boundaries.
- [Local authentication](/docs/security/local-auth): Configure self-hosted and break-glass local users.
- [OIDC](/docs/security/oidc): Connect an enterprise identity provider for browser login.
- [MFA security decision boundary](/docs/security/mfa-boundary): Understand where MFA is enforced and what application-managed MFA requires.
- [SCIM provisioning](/docs/security/scim): Provision users, groups, and memberships from a directory.
- [Roles, grants, and policies](/docs/security/authorization): Assign least-privilege access to securable resources.
- [Service principals and API tokens](/docs/security/tokens): Authenticate non-human workloads with scoped credentials.
- [Audit events](/docs/security/audit): Inspect security and administrative activity.
- [Audit privacy and retention](/docs/security/audit-privacy): Minimize, retain, and protect audit records and exports.
- [Dependency security clearance](/docs/security/dependency-clearance): Generate and verify content-bound dependency security evidence.
- [Security governance and release assurance](/docs/security/governance): Operate fail-closed repository, provenance, and promotion controls.

- [CLI overview](/docs/cli): Install, authenticate, validate, plan, and deploy with the CLI.

- [API quickstart](/docs/guides/integrate/api-quickstart): Authenticate and call the headless API.
- [API conventions](/docs/guides/integrate/api-conventions): Handle authentication, errors, and pagination consistently.
- [Headless BI queries](/docs/guides/integrate/headless-bi): Query dashboards and semantic models through stable contracts.
- [Public and embedded dashboards](/docs/guides/integrate/public-dashboards): Publish an anonymous governed dashboard and embed it on an allowed origin.
- [Agent integrations](/docs/guides/integrate/agent): Use global conversations and the shared governed tool catalog.
- [Use the agent tool catalog](/docs/guides/integrate/agent-tools): Find, inspect, and query governed resources through the curated tool surface.
- [Connect an MCP host](/docs/guides/integrate/mcp): Connect Claude and other MCP hosts to a LeapView deployment over OAuth.
- [Automation and CI](/docs/cli/automation): Run validation and deployments safely in CI.

#### Agent tools

- [Agent tool reference](/docs/agent-tools): Browse the exact tool contracts exposed by built-in chat and deployment MCP.
- [add_dashboard_page](/docs/agent-tools/add_dashboard_page): Add one dashboard page to a private draft using an exact expected revision.
- [add_dashboard_visual](/docs/agent-tools/add_dashboard_visual): Add a governed dashboard visual to a private draft using an exact expected revision.
- [assign_dashboard_field](/docs/agent-tools/assign_dashboard_field): Assign one governed semantic field to a dashboard visual in a private draft using an exact expected revision.
- [catalog_get](/docs/agent-tools/catalog_get): Resolve one exact authorized project resource ID and return its compact metadata.
- [catalog_list](/docs/agent-tools/catalog_list): Browse authorized project resources.
- [catalog_search](/docs/agent-tools/catalog_search): Search authorized project resources by stable ID, name, description, or domain metadata.
- [create_dashboard_draft](/docs/agent-tools/create_dashboard_draft): Create a private dashboard draft owned by the authenticated principal.
- [docs_read](/docs/agent-tools/docs_read): Read a bounded line window from one LeapView document returned by docs_search.
- [docs_search](/docs/agent-tools/docs_search): Search LeapView's version-matched product documentation.
- [execute_dashboard_command](/docs/agent-tools/execute_dashboard_command): Publish or archive one dashboard authoring revision using a closed, typed command and exact expected revision.
- [export_dashboard_yaml](/docs/agent-tools/export_dashboard_yaml): Export an authorized authored dashboard source as canonical project YAML.
- [fork_dashboard](/docs/agent-tools/fork_dashboard): Fork an authorized project or instance dashboard source into a private draft.
- [get_dashboard](/docs/agent-tools/get_dashboard): Get one authorized dashboard's governed metadata.
- [get_dashboard_draft](/docs/agent-tools/get_dashboard_draft): Read the exact current private draft and retained revision for one dashboard.
- [list_dashboards](/docs/agent-tools/list_dashboards): List the authorized project dashboard catalog.
- [preview_dashboard_draft](/docs/agent-tools/preview_dashboard_draft): Preview an exact private dashboard draft revision and page against the active governed runtime.
- [query_dashboard_visual](/docs/agent-tools/query_dashboard_visual): Query an existing dashboard visual with governed filters and compact analytical output
- [query_semantic_model](/docs/agent-tools/query_semantic_model): Query governed semantic data with typed columns, filters, pagination, and provenance
- [query_visual](/docs/agent-tools/query_visual): Create one read-only visual from LeapView semantic model fields.
- [set_dashboard_visibility](/docs/agent-tools/set_dashboard_visibility): Set a private dashboard draft's visibility using an exact expected revision.

#### CLI commands

- [CLI command reference](/docs/cli/reference): Browse every generated LeapView command.
- [leapview admin](/docs/cli/admin): Administrative utilities
- [leapview agent](/docs/cli/agent): Use the LeapView governed BI agent
- [leapview api](/docs/cli/api): Call any generated LeapView API operation
- [leapview build](/docs/cli/build): Build and seal a target-owned delivery plan
- [leapview config](/docs/cli/config): Inspect and validate process-global configuration
- [leapview dashboards](/docs/cli/dashboards): Inspect dashboards
- [leapview data](/docs/cli/data): Manage project-global data revisions
- [leapview deploy](/docs/cli/deploy): Deprecated composition of plan, build, and publish
- [leapview dev](/docs/cli/dev): Synchronize a project into your private target candidate
- [leapview evaluate](/docs/cli/evaluate): Run the self-contained local evaluation server
- [leapview healthcheck](/docs/cli/healthcheck): Check the local LeapView readiness endpoint
- [leapview login](/docs/cli/login): Sign in to a LeapView target for project authoring
- [leapview logout](/docs/cli/logout): Revoke a LeapView authoring session and remove local credentials
- [leapview plan](/docs/cli/plan): Capture an exact source snapshot and create a target-owned delivery plan
- [leapview publish](/docs/cli/publish): Publish an exact candidate through target policy
- [leapview rollback](/docs/cli/rollback): Governed rollback to a retained serving generation
- [leapview schema](/docs/cli/schema): Inspect LeapView YAML schemas
- [leapview search](/docs/cli/search): Search accessible product objects
- [leapview semantic-model](/docs/cli/semantic-model): Compile and interchange semantic models
- [leapview semantic-models](/docs/cli/semantic-models): Inspect semantic models
- [leapview serve](/docs/cli/serve): Run the LeapView HTTP server
- [leapview validate](/docs/cli/validate): Validate a configuration-as-code project
- [leapview version](/docs/cli/version): Report the LeapView build identity

#### API reference

- [API reference](/docs/api): Browse the generated headless API contract.
- [System](/docs/api/system): API capabilities and protocol discovery.
- [Instance](/docs/api/instance): The immutable serving identity of this LeapView installation.
- [Projects](/docs/api/projects): Active project graph assertion.
- [Releases](/docs/api/releases): Immutable project releases and artifacts.
- [Current User](/docs/api/current-user): Current principal, sessions, tokens, and capabilities.
- [Search](/docs/api/search): Progressive project-graph discovery across governed resources.
- [BI](/docs/api/bi): Dashboard and semantic model read APIs.
- [Connections](/docs/api/connections): Target-owned logical connection bindings, tests, refreshes, and redacted health.
- [Deployments](/docs/api/deployments): Atomic project release deployment.
- [Refresh Runs](/docs/api/refresh-runs): Headless refresh run operations.
- [Agent](/docs/api/agent): Headless agent conversation and run operations.
- [Access](/docs/api/access): Principals, groups, roles, and role bindings.
- [Audit](/docs/api/audit): Project audit event discovery.
- [Publications](/docs/api/publications): Anonymous public dashboard publication lifecycle.
- [Managed Data](/docs/api/managed-data): Project-global managed-data revisions and uploads.

### Architecture and contributing


#### Architecture

- [Architecture overview](/docs/architecture): See how the monolith, contracts, storage, and browser components fit together.
- [Runtime architecture](/docs/architecture/runtime): Follow routing, query execution, and streamed UI updates.
- [Semantic attribute registry](/docs/architecture/semantic-attribute-registry): Understand typed semantic attribute identity, ownership, lifecycle, and compatibility boundaries.
- [Evidence-gated Arrow optimization](/docs/architecture/arrow-optimization-evidence): Measure dashboard Arrow boundaries before approving a production migration.
- [Dashboard native Arrow response contract](/docs/architecture/dashboard-native-arrow-contract): Define the native-v1 schema, protocol, governance, pagination, and compatibility oracle for future dashboard Arrow experiments.
- [Cross-role journey qualification](/docs/architecture/journey-qualification): Map FAI-492 consumer, creator, and operator states to executable assembled-app checks and evidence rules.
- [GitHub-hosted CI](/docs/architecture/github-hosted-ci): Understand LeapView's ephemeral runners, bounded caches, and portable validation contract.
- [Durable audit and compliance controls](/docs/architecture/durable-audit-compliance): Understand audit guarantee classes, evidence boundaries, and compliance controls.
- [Storage architecture](/docs/storage-architecture): Understand DuckLake, DuckDB, snapshots, and serving pointers.
- [Datastar signal flow](/docs/architecture/datastar): Understand server-owned state and SSE response contracts.
- [Filter and slicer target architecture](/docs/architecture/filters-slicers): Understand semantic filter definitions, scoped bindings, canonical state, pane controls, slicers, and governed option queries.
- [Visualization architecture](/docs/architecture/visual-plugins): Understand the visualization IR, generated contracts, runtime data states, and renderer adapters.
- [Geographic rendering](/docs/architecture/geographic-rendering): Understand the MapLibre runtime boundary and geographic product guarantees.

#### Contributing

- [Repository and development workflow](/docs/contributing/repository): Work effectively in the LeapView monorepo.
- [Maintainability refactor contract](/docs/contributing/maintainability): Preserve behavior and capability ownership while extracting concentrated implementation complexity.
- [Add a visual type](/docs/contributing/visual): Extend contracts, rendering, documentation, and tests together.
- [Add a configuration resource](/docs/contributing/configuration): Extend schemas, generated references, and validation together.
- [Write documentation](/docs/contributing/documentation): Author procedural guides and accessible diagrams that remain valid with the product.
